name: integration-testing
details: Comprehensive manual integration testing of all memory commands with the unified tool interface. Test all parameter variations, nested directories, and edge cases.

tasks.name: Create integration test script
tasks.details: Write a comprehensive test script that exercises all commands with all parameter variations

tasks.name: Test view command
tasks.details: Test: empty dir, dir with files, dir with subdirs, file content, file with line range, file with EOF range

tasks.name: Test create command
tasks.details: Test: simple file, file in subdir, file with parent dir creation, overwrite existing file

tasks.name: Test str_replace command
tasks.details: Test: simple replace, replace in nested file, error on non-unique text, error on text not found

tasks.name: Test insert command
tasks.details: Test: insert at beginning, middle, end of file, insert in nested file

tasks.name: Test delete command
tasks.details: Test: delete file, delete empty dir, delete dir with contents, delete nested files

tasks.name: Test rename command
tasks.details: Test: rename file, move file to subdir, rename dir, move to non-existent parent (should create)
